name: SignPostMsg
meaning: Messages of the three sign classes (0x4f1a50, 0x4f1bea, 0x4f18c2).

name: MSG_USE
meaning: read: freeze Wolf (msg 0xE) and open. Sent by Wolf_DoAction 0x490c9a for ctx 1/7/9/0xA/0xB/0x1C/0x1D/0x21/0x24

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: -> 7 when idle, Wolf-sent and Manhattan XZ < DISTANCE

name: MSG_CONTAINER_STATE
meaning: SignPostSimple only: arg 1 (released from a container) savedPos = pos. Not a checkpoint message (senders: Mailbox, box, FloatingBox)

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: close immediately (Simple keeps wolfFrozen; SignPost/Animated clear it)

name: MSG_ANVIL_DROP
meaning: sent by SignPost to its ID_ANVIL object
